notes.title: V0.8.3 Balance Changes. UI Optimization.
notes.notes:
Cards

Neutral:

Purify:
Choose a card in your hand. Remove the chosen card from your deck, then draw 3 cards.
-> Choose a card in your hand. Remove the chosen card from your deck, then draw 4 cards.

Weak Potion:
Decrease the attack power of the target enemy by 2 this turn. 
-> Decrease the attack power of the target enemy by 3 this turn. 

Berserker:

Exchange:
Discard 2 cards, Gain 2 energy.
-> Discard 1 card, Gain 2 energy.
Exchange+:
Discard 1 card, Gain 2 energy.
-> Discard 1 card, Gain 3 energy.

Go Ballistic:
Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, add 2 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
-> Unplayable. If this card is discarded from your hand, add 3 Boiling Blood cards into your hand.

Bugmaster:

Burst: Costs 1 -> 3. 
Deal damage equal to the number of Parasitic cards in the target's body.
-> Deal damage equal to the number of cards in the target's body.

Behavioral Unification: Costs 2 -> 1. 
Behavioral Unification +:
For this turn, whenever you would deal 3 or less attack damage, increase it to 4.
-> For this turn, whenever you would deal 4 or less attack damage, increase it to 5.

Call Together:
Choose a card in your block pile. Put all cards from your life pile and block pile with that name into your hand.
-> Choose a card in your life pile. Put all cards from your life pile and block pile with that name into your hand.

Prophet:

Little Dipper: Costs 1 -> 2. Damage: 2 -> 4.
Spiritual Oppression: Costs 4 -> 5.  Damage: 6 -> 8.

Chaos Knight:

Horrify: Costs 2 -> 3.
Divine Hand: Costs 2 -> 1. Damage: 4 -> 2.
Shadow Sword: Damage: 4 -> 3.
Shield Bash: 
Deal 2 damage. Pray: Draw 3 non-Curse cards.
 -> Deal 2 damage. Pray: Draw 2 non-Curse cards.

Props

Neutral

Red Flower:
Every time you kill 8 enemies, gain 1 energy.
 -> Every time you kill 6 enemies, gain 1 energy.

Blue Flower:
Every time you play 10 cards, draw 1 card.
 -> Every time you play 10 cards, draw 2 cards.

Twig:
Every time you kill an elite enemy, gain 4 experience points.
 -> Every time you kill an elite enemy, gain 6 experience points.

Crimson Feather:
Every time you skip a card reward or prop reward, you gain an extra 5 gold.
 -> Every time you skip a card reward or prop reward, you gain an extra 10 gold.

Meditation Ring:
Whenever you play a card that costs 4 or more, gain 1 energy.
-> Whenever you play a card that costs 3 or more, gain 1 energy.

Berserker:

Ox Horn:
If you have only 1 card in your hand, that card costs 1 less energy.
 -> If you have only 1 card in your hand, that card costs 2 less energy.

Prophet:

Astral Dice:
Whenever you Foresee, deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row.
 -> Whenever you Foresee, deal 3 damage to a random enemy in the front row.

Dark Moon Staff:
Every time you Cast 5 cards, gain 1 energy.
 -> Every time you Cast 3 cards, gain 1 energy.

Astrology Book:
If you have no cards in your life pile, increase the damage of all Attack cards by 1.
 -> If you have no cards in your life pile, increase the damage of all Attack cards by 2.

Monster

Blood Hand：
HP: 7 -> 14
Range. Agile. Rebirth. Iron Defense -> Range. Agile. Rebirth.

Event

Strong Rat Men:
Open small package: Gain 50 gold coins. -> Gain 30 gold coins.

Musketeers:
Help shoot: Kill a non-boss enemy at random. -> Kill all non-boss enemies.

Orc Robber:
Loot the body of the Orc Robber: Gain 100 gold coins and add 2 Wound cards into your life pile. -> Gain 80 gold coins and add 1 Wound card into your life pile.
Search the body of the Orc Robber: Get 2 random props, and add 4 Wound cards into your life pile. -> Get 2 random props, and add 2 Wound cards into your life pile.

Phantom:
Suppress: Draw 2 cards, and the cost becomes 0. -> Draw 4 cards, and the cost becomes 0.

Mysterious Old Man:
Ring the bell: The attack power of all non-boss enemies on the field becomes 1. -> The attack power of all non-boss enemies on the field becomes 0.
Play flute: destroy all non-boss enemies in the middle row. -> Destroy all non-boss enemies.

Hemoptysis Bat:
Blood for blood: Remove 5 cards and get 5 card picks. -> Remove 1 prop and get 3 card picks.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed issue where Dark Spear card attack the wrong enemy.
Fixed issue where the Lizard Spy's attack power did not change correctly.

notes.title: V0.7.4 Balance Changes, UI Optimization
notes.notes:
Balance Changes
Arrow Rain +: Costs-1, Damage-1.

Heavy Blow: Costs 5->3, Damage 8->6.

Bloody Storm: Skill Card -> Attack Card，
Consume all current energy, add x Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
-> Consume all current energy, deal x damage and add x Boiling Blood cards into your hand.

Transfusion: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 1 more.
-> Discard your hand, then draw that many cards.

Transfusion +: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 2 more.
-> Discard your hand, then draw that many cards, and then draw 1 more.

Poison Needle +: Deal 3 damage. Your next Attack card deals 1 additional damage.
-> Deal 2 damage. Your next Attack card deals 2 additional damage.

Resonance: Costs+1.

Suppressing Insect: Costs-1.
Suppressing Insect +: This card can choose an enemy in the middle row. 

Dark Pulse: Costs+1, Damage+2. 

UI Optimization
Added the monster overview UI.
You can see the card or prop when your mouse hover over the option of events.
You can click on the monster to see the card inside, the popup should stays displaying the cards it took.
Some UI details were optimized.

Fixed Balanced Strike doesn't gain damage bonus from Sharpening Stone.
Fixed few localization issues.

notes.title: V0.7.3 New Monsters, New Events, Balance Changes
notes.notes:
4 elite monster has been added
[Fox] When dead, immediately end your current turn, and then take an extra turn.
[Iron Tree Essence] Frontline: Other enemies in the front row gain Iron Defense.
[Shaman Priest] Engage: Add 2 Weak cards into your life pile.
[Blood Hand] Range. Agile. Rebirth. Iron Defense.

4 new events have been added.

Balance Changes
All Out Swing:
    Upgrade: Damage+4 -> Upgrade: Damage+2

Rot:
    Upgrade: Damage+4 -> Upgrade: Damage+2

Shiv:
    Cost: 0 -> Cost: 1

Memory:
    Upgrade: Costs-1 -> Upgrade: Foresee+2

Meteor Shower:
    Deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row. This effect is repeated once for every 2 cards in your block pile.
-> Deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the front row. This effect is repeated once for every 3 cards in your block pile.

Red Flower:
     Every time you kill 10 enemies, gain 1 energy.
-> Every time you kill 8 enemies, gain 1 energy.

Blue Shield:
     After being attacked 10 times, gain immunity to the next attack.
-> After being attacked 8 times, gain immunity to the next attack.

Arrows:
    At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy in the middle row.
-> At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to a random enemy in the middle row.

Thistles and Thorns:
    Whenever you are attacked for the first time each turn, dead 2 damage back.
-> Whenever you are attacked for the first time each turn, dead 3 damage back.

Plague Stick:
    At the end of your turn, if you have at 3 or more cards in your hand, deal 2 damage to all enemies in the front row.
-> At the end of your turn, if you have at 4 or more cards in your hand, deal 2 damage to all enemies in the front row.

Fixed Close Quarters not putting Boiling Blood cards into your hand.
